paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
heading: Gog, Pathian Vanzat

paite: "Mihing tapa, Magog gam a mi, Rosh leh Meshek leh Tubal heutupen Gog masuan inla, atung ah thu gen in.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in, aw Gog, Rosh, Meshek leh Tubal heutupen, ka hon dou ahi.

Ka hon lehngatsak ding a, na haizek ah ngakuai in ka hon kuai ding a, ka hon khaikhe ding; na sepaihhon tengteng, sakol leh atungtuang mite, galvan buching a kithuam tengteng, pawl thupitak, lum lian leh lum neu zang a namsau tawi chiatte toh in.
Persia, Kush, Put toh, avek ua lum leh sik lukhu neite;
Gomer leh asepaihhon tengteng; Togarmah inkote, mal tawp a mi leh asepaihhon tengteng; na kiang a mi tampite toh leng.
Kigalgin inla, ahi, na man in, nang leh na kiang a omkhawm, na kithuahpih tengteng toh; huan amau vengpa na hi in.

Ni tampi nung in sap na hi ding a, kum nanungte ah namsau a kipan hotkhiak, nam tampite lak a kipan lakkhawmte omna gam, Israel tanggam kise gigete na hon sual ding a; himahleh namte lak a kipan huai mite pikhiak ahi ua, tu in avek un lungmuangtak in akhosa ding uhi.
Na kuantou ding a, huihpi bang mai in na hong tung ding a, meipi in gam atuam moimoi bang mai na hi ding, nang leh na kiang a sepaihhon tengteng leh na kiang a mi tampite."
Huan hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: “Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, na lungsim ah thil a hong lut ding a, thil hoih lou na suangtuah ding.
Huchi in kulh nei lou khuate gam ka sim ding a, mi bittak a om hiathiat, avek ua kulh lou a teng, kulh kongkhak leh akalhna sik neiloute ka sual ding, na chi sim ding hi.
Gallak sum leh vante la ding leh mun sesa nung luah nawn mite leh namte lak a kipan pikhawmsa, ganhon leh vante hau a, lei laizang a tengte tung ah na khut lik na tum ding hi.

Sheba leh Dedan leh Tarshish sumsin mite leh ahumpinelkai lun lai tengtengte'n na kiang ah, gallak la ding in na hong pai maw? Hon lok ding a na pawlte hon khawm na hi maw? Dangkasik, dangka-eng, ganhon leh van, thupitak suhsak a lamang ding na hi maw? ahon chi ding uh," chi in.
Huaiziak in mihing tapa, thu gen inla, Gog kiang ah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Huai ni, ka mi Israelte bittak a a-om hun ding uh na thei kei maw?
Mallam gam tawp pek, na mun a kipan in na hong pai ding a, nang leh na kiang a mi tampi sakol tungtuang chiat, pawl thupi mahmah, sepaihhon thupitak mai.

Meipi in gam atuam lunglung bang in ka mi Israelte tung ah na hong pai ding a; huan hichi ahi ding a, ni nanungte ah ka gam dou ding in ka hon pi ding a, namte'n ahon thei ding ua, Aw, Gog, amitmuh ua nang a hihsiangthou a ka om hun chiang in.
Huan Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Tuma lam a ka nasempa Israel zawlnei, huai lai kum tampi sung a thu na gente'n amaute sual ding a ka hon pi ding thu agen sekpa uh na hi hia? chi in," achi hi.
Huan huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Israel gam sual ding a Gog ahong kuan hun in ka mel ah ka thangpaihna akilang ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
heading: Pathian In Gog Agawtna

paite: Ka mullit a ka thangpaih laitak in, huai ni in Israel gam ah zin nakpi in aling ngeingei ding hi.

Huchi in tuipi ngate, tungleng vasate, gamsate, leitung a vak ganhing tengteng, leitung a mihing tengteng ka ma ah aling ding ua, tangte niamsak in a-om ding a, kawlte achim ding a, kulhbaang teng lei ah apuk ding, chi in ka gen hi.
Ka tang tengteng ah amah sualna ding in namsau ka sam ding a; michih in namsau in a-unaupa adou ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Huan sisan pawt leh hipi in amah ka sual ding a; amah leh asepaihhonte leh akiang a mi tampite tung ah vuahpi leh gial thupi leh mei katte ka zusak ding.
Huan ka thupidan leh ka sianthoudan ka hihlang ding a, nam tampite mitmuh in ka kihihlang ding, huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
